context: Riku, now graduating soon, has a quiet talk with his father Ryosuke about job decisions.
purpose: father-son adult conversation about young man's career path

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さん、ちょっと、就職のこと、相談していい？
lines.en: Dad, can I consult about jobs?
lines.style: Teen warm soft sincere brave-warm respectful-asking, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: もちろん。座って、ゆっくり話そう。
lines.en: Of course. Sit, let's talk slowly.
lines.style: Father warm gentle sincere-warm welcoming-dad, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 二つ内定もらってて、どっち選ぶか、迷ってる。
lines.en: I have two offers — stuck choosing.
lines.style: Teen warm soft sincere honest-vulnerable-warm sharing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: それは嬉しい悩み。どっちが、自分に合ってると感じる？
lines.en: A happy worry. Which feels right to you?
lines.style: Father warm gentle sincere-warm probing-deep, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うーん、大手の方が、安定してるけど、小さい方が、面白そう。
lines.en: Mm, big company stable, but smaller seems interesting.
lines.style: Teen warm soft sincere thoughtful-balanced-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お父さんも、若い時、同じ悩みがあった。今振り返ると、面白い方を選んで、良かった。
lines.en: I had the same worry when young. Looking back — glad I chose interesting.
lines.style: Father warm soft sincere deep-warm personal-disclosure, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さんの話、本当に参考になります。
lines.style: Teen warm soft sincere deep-warm grateful-disclosure, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 最終的には、リクが自分で決めるんだよ。お父さん、応援する。
lines.style: Father warm gentle sincere-warm firm-extending-closing, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう、お父さん。本当に、尊敬してる。
lines.en: Thanks, dad. Truly, I respect you.
lines.style: Teen warm soft sincere deep-warm closing-tender, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.
